tools.name: ginesys_get_item
tools.description: Get one inventory item by item code or barcode: division, department, category, vendor, prices (RSP, WSP, MRP, standard rate), tax group, unit of measure and stock settings. Ginesys GET /erp/gds/api/inv/item.

tools.name: ginesys_create_sales_order
tools.description: Create a sales order with its item lines in Ginesys ERP (POST /erp/gds/api/sales-order). Set intgOrderId to your own order id: Ginesys rejects a second order with the same id, so a retry cannot create a duplicate. Only itemDetails is required by this tool; the API returns a field error for any other

tools.name: ginesys_create_reservation
tools.description: Reserve stock for lines of an existing sales order at a site (POST /erp/gds/api/reservation). Give erpOrderCode or intgOrderId to find the order.

tools.name: ginesys_cancel_reservation
tools.description: Cancel part or all of a stock reservation on sales order lines (DELETE /erp/gds/api/reservation). Give erpOrderCode or intgOrderId to find the order.
